name: space_elevator_dawn

emotion_styles.hope: sun igniting the cable and the horizon, soaring optimistic light
emotion_styles.sad: cold shadow at the base of an endless tower, small and distant
emotion_styles.peace: slow climb above clouds, soft blue silence

camera_styles: long vertical tilt up the cable to the stars
wide ground shot of the tower's base
aerial view from above the cloud layer

stages.name: 昇降の窓
stages.prompt: beautiful anime interior, observation car window with a sea of clouds below and a curved horizon, soft glow of control panels, calm ascent

stages.name: 成層圏
stages.prompt: anime cinematic scene, climber capsule on a thin cable at the edge of space, deep blue gradient to starfield, thin atmosphere glow

stages.name: 静止軌道駅
stages.prompt: dramatic anime scene, vast ring-shaped orbital station at the end of the cable with Earth below, sunlight on metal, sparkling stars

stages.name: 帰路の夜明け
stages.prompt: poetic anime scene, Earth dawn terminator glowing blue and gold beyond a station window, slow drifting dust, quiet finale
